purpose: Teach: ボウル/信州/舞踏/南極/ドリブル/遊園/ラスベガス/ポルノ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、サラダボウルが大きいの買ったの
lines.en: Sho, I bought us a really big salad bowl.
lines.style: Warm, almost conversational. Speaking to a child with quiet affection. Gentle opening, like she's sharing something small and domestic with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、信州にお祖母ちゃんと行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to Shinshu with Grandma!
lines.style: Bright, excited, words tumbling out. The genuine happiness of a six-year-old sharing something that mattered. Not performed—real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと社交舞踏のお話したわ
lines.en: Sho, I talked with Dad about ballroom dancing.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little distant—memory-turned-conversation. Soft delivery, like she's still holding onto the moment. Speaking more to herself than to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、南極のペンギン大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really, really love Antarctic penguins!
lines.style: Pure enthusiasm. No filter, no self-consciousness. The specificity of a child's passion stated as absolute fact. Bright and earnest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼく、お父さんとドリブル練習したよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad and I practiced dribbling together.
lines.style: A slight shift in her voice—pride mixing with tenderness. She's remembering the moment with him. Warmer than before, grounded in something real and good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと遊園地行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to an amusement park with Dad.
lines.style: Hopeful, reaching. A small voice asking for something that matters. Not demanding—wondering if it's possible. The vulnerability of wanting something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラスベガスのお仕事に行ったわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad went to Las Vegas for work.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact on the surface, but there's a slight hesitation underneath. She's reporting information, but it carries weight. Steady tone, no complaints, but noticing he's not here.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ポルノって聞いたけど、何のこと?
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard someone say 'pornography,' but what does that mean?
lines.style: Innocent, genuinely curious. Direct question without any self-consciousness. The assumption that she'll know the answer. Open and trusting.
